description: Riff's windows: `main` and one pop-out per practice pane. The opener, dialog and window-state plugins are driven only from Rust and therefore need no JS permission, and there is no log plugin — frontend diagnostics go through our own log_write command. NOTE: Riff's own commands are NOT gated by this file. There is no src-tauri/permissions/, so Tauri's ACL check does not apply to them and every window can call every riff_handlers! command regardless of what is listed here. Adding a permissions manifest would make this file load-bearing overnight — the pop-out windows would lose IPC entirely unless they were granted the commands by name.
